This chain of relationships implies a potential pathway where Carmustine may exert its therapeutic effect on malignant gliomas through mechanisms that are not yet fully elucidated. The presence of a final score of 0.528 indicates a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, suggesting that while there is some evidence, further mechanistic investigation is warranted.
